'''Ka'van Aip''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shipmaster/Legends|shipmaster]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He worked at the [[Mos Ila Spaceport]].
